frontier.scope: The synthetic review covers the supplied mining-right assertion, one historical registry snapshot, one opaque community-governance reference and one spatial-unit reference. It does not claim complete coverage of all registries, courts, customary institutions or affected persons.

sources.reason: The only supplied registry snapshot predates the requested operation and is not proof of current register state.
The reference is present, but its mandate, decision process, scope and publication permission have not been verified.
The supplied feature does not include independently reviewed survey method, vertical datum or uncertainty fit for the proposed operation.
No currentness or revocation source was available within this declared frontier.

gaps.description: The competence, jurisdictional scope and current status of the referenced decision authority are not established.
gaps.required_evidence_or_action: Obtain an authoritative, current issuer and delegation record; have a qualified South African practitioner assess legal competence and scope.

gaps.description: The community governance reference does not establish representative mandate or whether all affected rights-holders have been identified.
gaps.required_evidence_or_action: Use a community-approved process and reviewer chosen through the relevant governance arrangements; preserve dissent and excluded-party concerns.

gaps.description: The spatial reference is not qualified for the proposed subsurface interest and may not represent the legally relevant volume.
gaps.required_evidence_or_action: Obtain an appropriately qualified survey and spatial representation, including CRS, vertical datum, effective date and uncertainty.

gaps.description: The registry snapshot is historical and cannot establish the current state of applications, transfers, restrictions or challenges.
gaps.required_evidence_or_action: Obtain a current source snapshot or official response and bind its exact version and capture time.

review_requirements.reviewer_role: South African land and mineral-rights legal practitioner
review_requirements.question: Which authority is competent for this specific operation and jurisdiction, and what current instrument establishes its scope and status?

review_requirements.reviewer_role: Appropriately registered land survey / geomatics professional
review_requirements.question: Does the source geometry represent the relevant surface or subsurface space, and are its CRS, vertical datum and uncertainty fit for this use?

review_requirements.reviewer_role: Reviewer selected under the affected community's own governance process
review_requirements.question: Which affected rights-holders, mandates, dissenting positions and purpose-specific data permissions must be preserved?

recheck_triggers: A current registry extract or official register response becomes available.
A relevant court, tribunal, regulator or customary-governance decision is received.
The authority reference is renewed, suspended or revoked.
A qualified spatial survey or vertical-datum record is added.
The affected community governance process records a new mandate, challenge or withdrawal.
limitations: Synthetic example only; no real land, community, party, registry or authority is represented.
This packet does not determine title, mining-right validity, statutory consent, representative legitimacy or the outcome of any legal process.
The packet records a review hold only. It is not yet integrated with the Mycelix Property transaction coordinator.
